name: APFSDS M829A3 (USA, 120 mm)
description: US 120 mm round (M1 Abrams). Depleted-uranium main rod about 670 mm long, 25 mm thick, ~1555 m/s. The real round also has a 100 mm steel tip section in front of the DU rod (meant to set off reactive armour) - not modelled, so the rod is shown flat-nosed. The Tank check uses depleted-uranium density and constants; a simulation runs it as tungsten alloy (DU strength data not in the simulator yet). Figures are public estimates.
